activity_summary: After supper you sat down to the king. The landing and the greeting of the earth were already done above. You wrote the two lines that sit him on the ground and ask for sad stories of the death of kings. You stayed in the chair. You did not walk it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat, and wrote the opening, and did not pace.

facets.activity: Sat and wrote the two lines on the death of kings
